title: HtmlSamp
responsibility: Renders the native samp element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSamp.attributes
inputs.description: Native samp attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSamp.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native samp element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSamp
outputs.description: The actual native samp element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
